units: <cite ref="Berakhot 6b:22">Ber. 6ᵇ</cite> (ref. to <he>כרם זלות</he>, <cite ref="Psalms 12:9">Ps. XII, 9</cite>) <he>אלו דברים … ברוֹמוֹ וכ׳</he> this means the things which stand on the height of the world (sublime things like prayer &c.) and which men treat lightly.
<cite ref="Megillah 14a:12">Meg. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>בני אדם שעומדין ברומו וכ׳</he> men that stood very high.
<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 2:3">Midd. II, 3</cite>; <cite ref="Mishnah Middot 3:6">III, 6</cite> <he>ר׳ מעלה וכ׳</he> the height of each step was &c.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 199:7">Sifré Deut. 199</cite> <he>גדול השלום שדרי ר׳ וכ׳</he> peace is something great, for the dwellers on high (angels) need peace; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 923:14">Yalk. ib. 923</cite>; a. e.
